---
title: "Mplus diagram: fresh-session offline report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: null
    mathjax: null
params:
  config_file: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(MplusAutomation)
options(viewer = function(...) stop("Viewer must not open during render"),
        browser = function(...) stop("Browser must not open during render"))
stopifnot(!interactive())
cfa_file <- system.file("extdata", "mplus-diagram", "cfa-ml.out", package = "MplusAutomation")
sem_file <- system.file("extdata", "mplus-diagram", "ex5.11.out", package = "MplusAutomation")
stopifnot(nzchar(cfa_file), nzchar(sem_file), file.exists(params$config_file))
config_before <- readBin(params$config_file, "raw", file.info(params$config_file)$size)
```

The first diagram uses a saved configuration with a Chinese display name and
saved node position. The second diagram has its own initial state and controls.
Both read fixed results; rendering does not estimate a model or open an editor.

```{r cfa, echo=FALSE}
cfa <- mplus_diagram(cfa_file, config = params$config_file)
stopifnot(cfa$x$state$aliases[["node:F1"]] == "研究构念甲",
          cfa$x$state$views$full$nodes[["node:F1"]]$x == 631,
          cfa$x$state$options$digits == 3)
cfa
```

The SEM source did not request standardized results. Its displayed scale is
explicitly unstandardized; there is no invented standardized table.

```{r sem, echo=FALSE}
sem <- mplus_diagram(sem_file, options = list(scale = "unstandardized"))
stopifnot(sem$x$state$options$scale == "unstandardized",
          is.null(sem$x$state$aliases[["node:F1"]]))
sem
```

```{r verify, include=FALSE}
stopifnot(identical(config_before,
  readBin(params$config_file, "raw", file.info(params$config_file)$size)))
stopifnot(is.null(cfa$x$editor), is.null(sem$x$editor))
```

Offline HTML adjustments remain in the current document session. Use the
configuration download to preserve them, then supply that file to `config`
in a later R call. Reloading the document restores its embedded initial state.
